poc-0e1b17.title: Pilot Tool Retrieval for scaling agentic data pipelines
poc-0e1b17.problem: Managing large tool libraries in multi-step AI agents inflates input token counts and latency, limiting DPA's ability to scale agentic data pipelines cost-effectively.
poc-0e1b17.proposal: Integrate Tool Retrieval into an existing Gemini-based agent workflow with 50+ tools to load parameter schemas on demand, reducing token counts and latency without inflating costs.
plan: Build test harness using public or synthetic documents with 50+ tools.
Integrate Tool Retrieval into the Gemini-based agent workflow.
Measure token costs and latency compared to static loading.
poc-0e1b17.metric: Compare input token counts and latency against static loading in an agent workflow with 50+ tools.
poc-0e1b17.data_safety: Public or synthetic data first; no client data on free tiers; check the licence and data terms.

poc-7e2c3b.title: Pilot MAI Code 2 for data pipeline engineering velocity
poc-7e2c3b.problem: DPA needs to improve developer velocity for data pipeline engineering tasks without compromising code quality.
poc-7e2c3b.proposal: Test MAI Code 2 and Flash on GitHub Copilot to evaluate performance and speed for internal pipeline engineering workflows.
plan: Set up trial on GitHub Copilot with public repositories.
Test MAI Code 2 on pipeline coding tasks.
Compare developer velocity against baseline methods.
poc-7e2c3b.metric: Field accuracy vs the current step, minutes saved per document.
poc-7e2c3b.data_safety: Public or synthetic data first; no client data on free tiers; check the licence and data terms.

poc-8e37a6.title: Pilot Gemini Decisions API for fund-filing compliance checks
poc-8e37a6.problem: Manual compliance checks on high-volume fund filings are time-consuming and prone to bottlenecks during peak reporting cycles, delaying error-catching before client deliverables are finalized.
poc-8e37a6.proposal: Pilot the Gemini Decisions API using public and synthetic PDF fund notices to automate high-volume binary decisions, compliance checklist validations, and multi-modal QA tasks, integrating probability scoring into our review workflow.
plan: Prepare 50 public or synthetic PDF fund notices with known compliance checklist items.
Integrate Gemini Decisions API to run bounded-choice scoring on the test set.
Measure response latency, per-request token costs, and scoring accuracy against ground truth.
Evaluate results and document recommendations for high-volume compliance checks.
poc-8e37a6.metric: Measure API latency (target under 250ms), cost per document, and match accuracy against hand-checked compliance checklists for 50 test fund notices.
poc-8e37a6.data_safety: Test initially with public or synthetic PDFs only; never send client data on external API tiers. Verify Google's data retention, privacy terms, and zero-retention options before wider production use.

poc-cda2c8.title: Pilot Claude Meetings for internal scoping call notes
poc-cda2c8.problem: DPA teams spend valuable time manually taking notes and drafting follow-up documents after internal scoping and research calls, slowing down project kickoff.
poc-cda2c8.proposal: Pilot Anthropic's Claude Meetings beta feature to join internal video calls, automatically take notes, answer questions, and draft follow-up documents to streamline post-call workflows.
plan: Set up Claude Meetings on a Team or Enterprise plan for Google Meet.
Run and record three internal scoping calls using the tool.
Compare generated notes and follow-up drafts against manual summaries.
Document time saved and note accuracy for the team.
poc-cda2c8.metric: Evaluated by comparing Claude's meeting notes and follow-up drafts against manual summaries from three internal scoping calls for completeness and editing time.
poc-cda2c8.data_safety: Use only for internal scoping or synthetic meeting recordings; verify Anthropic's enterprise data retention terms and ensure zero training on enterprise inputs before any client use.
